fact: 1924年12月圣保罗州设立「咖啡永久保护研究所」（Instituto do Café / São Paulo Institute for the Permanent Defense of Coffee），1925年咖啡计划的执行权正式移交给该所；1925—1926年间限产保价机制逐步完善：限制内地运往桑托斯港的配额、建立最低价制度。此前联邦政府在1922年设过全国咖啡研究所作贷款机构，但保罗州更信任州级干预。

sources.title: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Brazil's Coffee Industry（King 著，Archive.org）
sources.quote: A National Coffee Institute was established in 1922, as a lending agency for State Institutes. However, São Paulo growers, who produced about three-fourths of all Brazilian coffee, apparently had more confidence in State intervention than producers of other States, and in 1925 the responsibility for the coffee program was given over to the São Paulo Institute for the Permanent Defense of Coffee. During 1925 and 1926, mechanisms for control were perfected. Port entries were continued in modified and more flexible forms.

sources.title: Latin American Research Review, Coffee Planters, Politics, and Development in Brazil
sources.quote: the creation of the Instituto de Cafe-do Estado de Sao Paulo in 1924-25, placed the state government in the middle of this complex and pivotal issue. ... The state coffee institute was created in December 1924 after the federal government, under Artur Bernardes (1922-1926), decided to abandon coffee price protection altogether.

fact: 1920年代咖啡出口占巴西出口收入的70%以上；咖啡保护研究所的资金来源为运输税收入与外国银行贷款，通过收购并扣留库存把咖啡挡在世界市场之外以维持价格。此前第二、第三次valorization（一战末与1920—21年）分别购入300万袋与近500万袋。

sources.title: Harrell's History, The Great Depression and the Americas 1929-39（IB教材）
sources.quote: In the 1920s, coffee exports were the source of over 70% of the country's revenue. ... To take more control, in 1925 Brazil created the São Paulo Institute for Permanent Defense of Coffee. To keep coffee prices high, the institute would purchase and withhold its goods from the world market. To pay for the coffee, the institute received the revenue from a transportation tax and took out loans from foreign banks.

sources.title: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Brazil's Coffee Industry
sources.quote: Toward the end of World War I, when production exceeded exports by a substantial margin the Federal Government loaned enough money to the São Paulo State Government to purchase 3 million bags of coffee. ... In this program nearly 5 million bags were purchased and stored. Stocks were held in Brazil during the second and third valorization

fact: 咖啡价格历史锚点：1920年中23美分/磅跌至1921年初约9美分/磅，触发第三次valorization；1926年9月回升到22美分/磅。1924年前后联邦已建成11座「调节仓库」（regulatory warehouses），总容量约350万袋（约5亿磅）。

fact: 咖啡研究所拥有广泛管制权：设定内地运往桑托斯港的装运配额、建立最低价、扣留剩余库存；种园主（fazendeiros）对失去渠道控制权不满，1924—1926年间咖啡精英与政治领导层的裂痕扩大（1924年7月圣保罗叛乱的后续）。外来经营者进入咖啡贸易须依附州级机构与既有商号网络。

sources.title: Latin American Research Review, Coffee Planters, Politics, and Development in Brazil
sources.quote: Because the Coffee Institute was granted extensive powers to regulate the coffee economy and establish quotas to limit shipments to the port of Santos from the interior, the government was in a position to determine the fate of regions and producers. ... Planters cried out loudly against their lack of institutionalized control of the coffee economy and came to oppose many of the institute's policies.

fact: 圣保罗州咖啡产量约占全巴西四分之三，咖啡经铁路运往桑托斯港出口；1923年联邦建设的「调节仓库」体系与铁路运输税是保价政策的物流与财政基础。巴西整体制造业基础薄弱，制成品依赖进口，出口利润大量外流。

sources.quote: Access to the Sao Paulo's transportation and commercial systems emerged as continuing issues in their own right with the construction in 1923 of "regulatory warehouses" by the federal government.

sources.title: Harrell's History, The Great Depression and the Americas 1929-39
sources.quote: There was a small, emerging industrial base in several cities, but it was limited; most manufactured goods came from overseas, meaning that most profits from export were spent overseas, and there was a substantial outflow of capital.

fact: 咖啡保价体系的分配效应：大种植园主（fazendeiros）从价格支持中获益最多，小农与农业工人分享有限；研究所与外国贷款的还本付息压力最终传导到出口税与运输税上。1920年代末巴西外债约9亿美元、年偿付约1.75亿美元，全靠出口盈余支撑。

sources.title: Harrell's History, The Great Depression and the Americas 1929-39
sources.quote: On the eve of the Depression, Brazil's foreign debt was $900 million and the government paid out approximately $175 million per year in repayment of loans, relying on the profits of the export trade to make their annual payments.

fact: 1924年7月圣保罗发生的武装叛乱及其余波在1924—1926年间持续撕裂咖啡精英与政府关系；外来者在此环境中经营须关注政局对运输、信贷与治安的扰动。本条只记录政治动荡的存在与影响面，不展开军事细节。

sources.title: Latin American Research Review, Coffee Planters, Politics, and Development in Brazil
sources.quote: The months between late 1924 and early 1926 fatefully widened the rift between the coffee elite and political leaders, as in the already noted processes of implosion in all major elite associations, the rebellion of July 1924, and its aftermath.
